messages:
Elena: Quick sync — planning the console observability roadmap for H2. I want alignment on a minimal launch surface for dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, and error analytics. My proposed cut: dashboard widgets (top endpoints, latency P95 + trend), lightweight tracing hooks (span IDs + trace links), per-route cost breakdown (daily + rolling 7d), and an error-rate heatmap. Low-risk defaults, customer pilot, then expand. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Raj: Strong +1 on per-route cost. Customers keep asking for cost attribution to feature teams. Can we ship cost breakdown first as a read-only view and iterate? Sampling + derived estimates might be OK for launch.

Marta: Agree cost is high-impact. Small note: tracing hooks are important for error analytics — without trace context it's hard to root cause. Could we ship "trace pointers" (span id + link to trace store) instead of full span ingestion initially?

Tim: From infra side — full-span capture at high QPS is expensive. A trace-pointer/sampling approach makes sense. Suggest default sampling = 1% with ability to raise for canary/pilot. Also need an autoscale policy for the trace-ingest workers.

Samir: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- Cost breakdown beta available in console with per-route + per-model view
- Dashboard baseline widgets (latency P95, throughput, error rate) + CSV export
- Tracing hooks: trace-pointer + 1% sampling + link-through to trace explorer
- Error analytics: heatmap + top error messages with one-click drill to traces
- Acceptance: 2 pilot customers onboarded, <200ms median dashboard query latency in staging, unit/regression tests and e2e smoke

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: cost-breakdown/proto -> staging at 2432104600 by ci/cd-bot :package:

Raj: Owner suggestions: I'll own cost-breakdown front-end + pilot. @Marta take tracing hooks + trace-linking. @Tim infra for sampling/autoscale. @Samir define acceptance tests and onboard pilots.

Marta: I can own tracing work but need an ETA — realistically 3 sprints to have stable trace-pointers and the linking flow. If we trim scope (no full span indexing) I can do it in 2 sprints.

Tim: Please drop an infra req doc with expected QPS, avg trace size, and retention. I can give compute estimates after that. Also we should add a circuit-breaker so traces don't saturate the store during incidents.

Elena: Action items:
1) Raj to ship cost-breakdown staging prototype and share screenshots in #product by EOD Friday.
2) Marta to draft tracing-pointer RFC and list minimal schema by next Wed.
3) Tim to produce infra cost/scale estimate after receiving the req doc.
4) Samir to write acceptance criteria + pilot runbook and list customers for pilot.
5) I'll schedule a 30m prioritization sync next Tue to lock launch surface.

Samir: Also add telemetry hooks: token cost delta alert, dashboard query latency alert, and error-rate spike alert with automatic rollbacks for UI changes. We should surface unit-cost per route in the UI somewhere (even approximate) so PMs can make decisions. :rocket:

Raj: Noted — I'll include an "estimated unit-cost" column in the per-route table (explain assumptions).

Marta: Quick question — for error analytics drilldown, do we want a link to the trace explorer (external) or inline small trace viewer? Inline viewer = more work. Leaning external link for MVP.

Elena: Agree external link for MVP; inline viewer for later. OK if we capture minimal trace context and store link only.

Tim: I'll ensure the trace-pointer format is stable (trace_id:span_id, sampling_bit) and add rate-limiting.

Elena: Thanks team. If no objections, I'll take these as the working plan and we can adjust after staging tests. :thumbsup:

Raj: LGTM.

Marta: LGTM.

Samir: LGTM.

Tim: LGTM.
